sources.claim: CrowdStrike describes DoppelPaymer as sharing most of its code with BitPaymer and as a fork of the BitPaymer code base.
NHS Digital describes DoppelPaymer as based on older BitPaymer malware.

curator_note: Modeled as a directed fork because one source explicitly uses code-fork language and a second public alert describes DoppelPaymer as based on BitPaymer.
confidence_reason: Two public sources support the direction from DoppelPaymer back to BitPaymer, with CrowdStrike providing the stronger code-level basis.
